summary: ChronoScale Corp filed an 8-K/A (Amendment No. 2) to report the consummation of a business combination with Applied Digital Cloud Corp (Cloud), a subsidiary of Applied Digital Corp, on May 5, 2026. ChronoScale, formerly Ekso Bionics Holdings, acquired Cloud in a reverse merger, changed its name to ChronoScale Corp, and Cloud became a wholly owned subsidiary. The filing includes required financial statements and pro forma information for Cloud. No specific deal terms (price, premium, or consideration) are provided in the excerpt. The transaction closed on May 5, 2026; watch for post-merger integration and financial performance disclosures.
